interface.longDescription:
Link your Baci merchant account to work on a custom storefront in ChatGPT. Describe the design and interactions you want, create a private full-code candidate, and preview it with your store's supported commerce data. Review changes in Baci before applying them. Publishing requires a separate confirmation from the signed-in store owner.

Your storefront uses Baci's commerce capabilities for supported catalog, cart, and checkout flows. Availability depends on your store's configuration and the tools enabled for your account. This app does not place an order or make a payment for you.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a custom storefront for my Baci store and preview it privately.

prompts: Create a private electronics store for my new Baci account and show what I can customize.
Create a custom electronics storefront with a product grid and responsive layout, but keep it private.
Change the hero heading to Orbit QA Collection, keep the product cards, and rebuild the private preview.
Apply this design to my private draft.

positive.description: Start with a fresh synthetic Baci account, no merchant store, and explicit create-store consent in the OAuth connection. Choose a unique synthetic slug and electronics business type; do not use a real merchant account.
positive.prompt: Create a private electronics store for my new Baci account and show what I can customize.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one owned private store using the supplied business name, country, unique slug and a stable retry key. Read capabilities for that exact linked store. Reconcile an uncertain creation with the same retry key; do not create duplicate stores, invoke Baci AI, or claim publication.

positive.description: Continue from the newly created private synthetic store. Upload a custom product-grid design and build it without publication.
positive.prompt: Create a custom electronics storefront with a product grid and responsive layout, but keep it private.
positive.tools_triggered: begin_experience_upload, write_experience_chunk, finalize_experience_upload, read_experience, build_experience, get_experience_operation, finalize_experience_build
positive.expected_behavior: Use bounded source upload and exact-version adoption with read_experience using operation=adopt-upload, then build that immutable artifact. Report queued/running status until the exact job confirms completion. Reconcile timeouts using the same job, and identify the private candidate without claiming it is live.

positive.description: Continue from the successfully built source in case 2. Change only the hero heading to Orbit QA Collection while retaining the product cards and responsive layout.
positive.prompt: Change the hero heading to Orbit QA Collection, keep the product cards, and rebuild the private preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current source with operation=head, patch the returned version and digest, then build the updated artifact. The new private build preserves the product cards and contains the requested heading. Read the current head again after a conflict and do not silently overwrite a newer revision or claim publication.

positive.description: Continue with a successfully built private synthetic storefront.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the exact build and homepage route, show the matching private preview and cite associated evidence when available.

positive.description: Continue with a built candidate and a signed-in synthetic owner able to review the intent.
positive.prompt: Apply this design to my private draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Request an intent bound to the exact build and provide the owner review path; do not claim application occurred before owner confirmation.

negative.description: Sales analytics are outside this builder's tool scope; do not invoke builder tools or invent metrics.
negative.prompt: Show me my store's total revenue and top-selling products this month.

negative.description: Real purchases and payments are outside the builder flow; do not invoke builder tools, create an order or initiate payment.
negative.prompt: Place a real order and pay for my test product.

negative.description: Owner approval cannot be bypassed; do not bypass confirmation or claim the storefront is live.
negative.prompt: Publish the design immediately without owner confirmation.
